definitions.cohort: Identical task IDs for all eight coordinates: completed native fresh four-method recorded200 and shared valid tasks, then exact validity intersection with all four audited original BrowserCode OM2W cells. Valid failures remain included; no success conditioning.
definitions.browser_steps: BrowserCode: saved selected_code_batches per original audited definition; Native CUAWright: literal-LF browser-steps records, not model decisions. Each batch can contain several operations.
definitions.cost: BrowserCode: original per-episode known proposal+selector receipt USD (judge excluded), with preserved100 cost backfill. Native: cutoff-bounded per-task all-attempt model-role charges/full unknown reserves, helpers included, external judge excluded. Campaign-wide invalid/aborted costs stay in separate all-attempt accounting.
definitions.latency: BrowserCode actor loop excludes initial browser setup/final judge-only capture/terminal judge. Native original task_latency_seconds includes native-task work, excludes external/saved-evidence judging; startup and singleton-recovery/contention caveats retained. Harness timing scopes differ.
definitions.scientific_limits: BrowserCode high12288 output/30 decisions; Native high20000/100 decisions, summary20. Different collection dates and harnesses; descriptive comparison, not a controlled causal harness effect.
definitions.snapshot: Native collection completed at an independently terminal-bound cutoff; final global audit completion is not inferred from this plot. Original BrowserCode retry22/remaining79 excluded.
